headline:
Buying In South Metro
More Homes In Most Counties
turn_1: Echo, FMLS numbers for August show more homes for sale than a year earlier in Henry, Clayton, Fayette and Spalding counties.
turn_2: All of South Metro? So buyers have more to pick from everywhere?
turn_3: Not everywhere. Rockdale and Newton had slightly fewer. Henry, the biggest, had 1,016 homes for sale, up 14.5% from a year earlier.
echo_line: Most counties, not all. …Oh. Where I look matters as much as when.
source: FMLS via Simply List Atlanta, August 2026 county reports · retrieved Oct 17, 2026
disclaimer: General market information for South Metro Atlanta, not advice about any home or purchase. Numbers change month to month.
